responsibility: Contains the main autogenerated manual-link mapping for options declared in gcc/config/rs6000/rs6000.opt. It associates the core rs6000 backend switches—covering ISA features, ABI choices, tuning controls, scheduling flags, vector/crypto/HTM/MMA enablement, stack-protector forms, and related target options—with GCC manual URL suffixes, making it the documentation companion to the primary PowerPC option table used by generated option help and references.
